methods.name: Spatial panel ML (spml): within (individual, time, two-way) and pooled lag, error and SARAR models
methods.reference: written out (splm not installed): Elhorst (2003), Baltagi, Song & Koh (2003), Millo & Piras (2012) likelihoods, optimize/optim with a Newton polish, SEs from the Richardson Jacobian of the analytic score (numDeriv 2016.8.1.1); plm::plm(model = 'within', effect = ...) 2.6.7 for the non-spatial within coefficients (validation/r/cases/spatial_splm.R)
methods.tolerance: n = 294. Parameters Tol::iterative(1e-8) and logLik 1e-10, because the Newton profile optimiser converges quadratically to the root of the analytic profile gradient (R's optimum is Newton-polished to |gradient| < 1e-9). SEs Tol::iterative(1e-6): central differences of the analytic score against R's Richardson Jacobian. The non-spatial within fits at validation/README.md (coef 1e-8, SE and statistics 1e-6).
